full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white studio photograph shows a short-haired figure seated on the floor under a diagonal shaft of light. The figure wears a dark tailored jacket with narrow shoulders and a long dark lower garment that spreads over the floor to the left. The head tilts down, and one hand rises to the side of the face, partially hiding the cheek. The face is almost entirely in shadow, while a narrow silver highlight catches the hairline, forehead, and collar. The body forms a compact vertical silhouette just right of center, with the dark skirt-like shape extending as a low horizontal base. Behind, a broad beam of white light enters from the upper right and cuts toward the lower left across a plain wall. Its softened edge creates a pale triangular field, bordered by deep black at the upper left and bottom right. The shadow of the seated figure merges into the black floor, making the lower contours difficult to separate. Fine film grain and a slightly smoky tonal transition keep the beam from looking mechanically sharp. There is no visible furniture or set decoration; pose, light, and shadow supply the scene. The strongest illumination is behind and above the subject, giving a restrained rim light rather than a fully lit portrait. The close-to-monochrome value design makes the bent head and raised hand the emotional focus. A large diagonal of light opposes the still, inward-curled body, creating a solitary, theatrical calm.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白影棚摄影呈现一位短发人物坐在地上，处于斜向光束之下。人物穿深色剪裁外套，肩线狭窄，下身长深色衣物向左铺在地面。头低垂，一只手抬到脸侧，部分遮住面颊。脸几乎全在阴影里，发际、额头和衣领只接到一道窄银光。身体在中央稍右形成紧凑竖向剪影，深色裙状形块向左延成低水平基底。后方一束宽白光从右上进入，斜切过素墙通向左下。柔软光边形成浅色三角场，其外是左上与右下的深黑。坐姿人物的影子融入黑地板，下部轮廓难以分开。细胶片颗粒和略带烟雾感的明暗过渡使光束不显机械锐利。没有可见家具或布景；姿态、光和影提供整个场景。最强照明在人物背后和上方，只留下克制轮廓光，而非全亮人像。近乎单色的明度设计让低首和抬手成为情绪焦点。一道巨大光的对角线对照静止、内收的身体，形成孤独而舞台化的平静。
style_prompt_en: A high-contrast black-and-white studio photograph is organized by one broad diagonal light field cutting through deep black. A compact dark upright silhouette sits near the center, its lower mass spreading into a shadowed horizontal base. Only thin silver rim highlights identify selected contours; the main surface remains near-black. The light beam has a soft smoky edge and a gentle grain rather than a hard digital boundary. Background detail is absent, so value geometry and pose-like compression carry the composition. Backlighting creates separation without flattening the dark shape, and cast shadows merge with the surrounding floor. The palette is restricted to velvet black, luminous white, and a few soft middle grays. A large active diagonal and a still inward focal form produce an austere, contemplative rhythm.
style_prompt_zh: 高反差黑白影棚摄影由一片宽阔斜向光场切过深黑构成。紧凑深色竖向剪影坐在中央附近，下部色团铺成阴影水平基底。只有纤细银灰轮廓高光标出少数边缘，主体表面仍接近黑。光束边缘柔软带烟雾和轻颗粒，而非坚硬数字界线。背景细节缺席，因此明度几何与姿态般的压缩承担构图。逆光让暗形分离，却不把它照平，投影与周围地面融合。配色限制在天鹅绒黑、发光白和少量柔中灰。大幅活跃对角线与内收静止的焦点形体形成严峻、沉思的节奏。
theme_en: A short-haired figure seated beneath a diagonal studio spotlight
theme_zh: 斜向影棚聚光下坐着的短发人物
name: George Platt Lynes
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
